function localArrays() {
  interface Array<T> { consume: (value: T) => void; }
  interface ReadonlyArray<T> { consume: (value: T) => void; }
  const narrow: Array<string> = {consume: value => console.log(value.toUpperCase())};
  const wide: Array<string | number> = narrow;
  const narrowReadonly: ReadonlyArray<string> = {consume: value => console.log(value.toUpperCase())};
  const wideReadonly: ReadonlyArray<string | number> = narrowReadonly;
  wide.consume(1);
  wideReadonly.consume(2);
}
function localContainers() {
  interface ReadonlyMap<K, V> { consume: (key: K, value: V) => void; }
  interface ReadonlySet<T> { consume: (value: T) => void; }
  interface ArrayIterator<T> { consume: (value: T) => void; }
  const map: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = {consume: (key, value) => console.log(key.toUpperCase(), value)};
  const wideMap: ReadonlyMap<string | number, string | number> = map;
  const set: ReadonlySet<string> = {consume: value => console.log(value.toUpperCase())};
  const wideSet: ReadonlySet<string | number> = set;
  const iterator: ArrayIterator<string> = {consume: value => console.log(value.toUpperCase())};
  const wideIterator: ArrayIterator<string | number> = iterator;
}
function noArrayShortcut() {
  interface ArrayLike<T> { value: T; }
  const local: ArrayLike<number> = [1, 2];
}
class Numbers extends Array<number> {}
const numbers: Array<number> = [1, 2];
const strings: Array<string> = numbers;
const mutable: Array<number> = [1, 2] as ReadonlyArray<number>;
const wrongSubclass: Numbers = ['wrong'];
const map: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = new Map<number, string>([[1, 'wrong']]);
const set: ReadonlySet<number> = new Set<string>(['wrong']);
const iterator: ArrayIterator<number> = ['wrong'].values();
